envelope.description: Share the existing provider lane with probes

body.title: Share the existing provider lane with probes
body.summary: Extract existing module-private providerTail ownership from src/daemon/review-investigation-repository.ts into a proposed src/daemon/review-investigation-provider-lane.ts; use it from review and probe orchestration with unchanged drain semantics. Do not add a second queue.
acceptanceChecks: Two review/probe requests across repos never overlap provider invocation.
Queued cancellation makes no model call or lease acquisition; active cancellation holds lane until real teardown.
Prior repository concurrency/recovery behavior remains intact.

tests.name: Probe and review across repositories share one lane until actual teardown
Cancelling queued probe does not invoke provider or release another owner's slot
